about: A Go library for reading and writing Excel spreadsheets.

prs.title: Edits after saving a new sheet land in the right cells
prs.broken: After saving a file with a new or copied sheet, later edits and formulas on that sheet could go to the wrong cells, with no error.
prs.changed: Each sheet is now reloaded in full after it is saved, so its rows and cells stay where they belong.
prs.matters: Programs that save a report and keep editing it no longer corrupt the data.
